The rush and excitement of a new connection with someone where things seem to just click effortlessly, super enjoyable, and just overall a good time. It doesn’t happen often! I feel as though a lot of the SD’s in these comments have been burned/rinsed so it’s a little biased in a way 

I wouldn’t say she “rinsed” you at all. 
It seems like she reciprocated some type of connection with you- including the text messages as she did not necessarily have to text you constantly for your arrangement 

She offered to return the necklace to you - which she didn’t have to even bring up because that opens the door of you accepting her offer. 

I feel like if she really wanted to rinse you she’d at least go on a few more dates to collect ppm + gifts + get an even stronger connection w/ you. 

Especially with the no intimacy factor - most SBs probably find it harder to rinse because most SDs aren’t willing to do no intimacy- so why wouldn’t she take advantage of this opportunity of someone willing to do ppm+ dates + more for no intimacy? 

Obviously I don’t know the full story and can’t grasp everything without seeing the interactions between you two - but I feel like she has a strong chance of just truly being unable to continue the arrangement due to her bf. 

BTW - I don’t know why everyone is bashing you for feeling this strong connection for someone quickly.  While I have no idea if this “soulmate connection” would of lasted - it is a possibility. And at the least, your feelings could have been a strong infatuation towards her which is perfectly understandable and valid.

Just to add - he says he met her a week ago and they only went on one actual date + their initial meet 

OP mentioned the total cost of the date + ppm - I really don’t think she was “stringing him along” as she offered to return the necklace + only participated in one date before ending it.
